target_note: _Note: CPS recommended target stack is ruff, mypy, pytest + pytest-cov, pip-audit._

Linter.label: linting
Linter.replaces: Linting: replaces {tools} (ruff reimplements their common rules, much faster).

Formatter.label: formatting
Formatter.missing: Formatting: use `ruff format` (no extra dependency once ruff is present).

Security.label: security checks
Security.missing: Security: enable the `S` (flake8-bandit) rules with `extend-select = ["S"]` in `[tool.ruff.lint]`.
Security.replaces: Security: replaces {tools} with the `S` (flake8-bandit) rules via `extend-select = ["S"]`.

Complexity.label: complexity checks
Complexity.missing: Complexity: enable the `C90` (mccabe) rules with `extend-select = ["C90"]` and set `[tool.ruff.lint.mccabe] max-complexity`.
Complexity.replaces: Complexity: replaces {tools} with the `C90` (mccabe) rules via `extend-select = ["C90"]`.

ruff.add_dependency: Add ruff as a dev dependency and configure `[tool.ruff]` in `pyproject.toml`.
ruff.remove: Remove {tools} from dev dependencies, pre-commit and CI once ruff covers them.

setup.title: Add mypy for type checking
bullets: Add mypy as a dev dependency and configure `[tool.mypy]` in `pyproject.toml`.

Type checker.declare: Declare the type checker as a dev dependency and configure it in `pyproject.toml` so local runs match CI.

setup.title: Add pytest as the test runner
bullets: Add pytest as a dev dependency and configure `[tool.pytest.ini_options]`.

Test runner.declare: Declare the test runner as a dev dependency and configure it in `pyproject.toml` so local runs match CI.
Test runner.ci: Run the test suite (e.g. `pytest`) in CI on `pull_request`.

setup.title: Add pytest-cov for coverage
bullets: Add pytest-cov as a dev dependency and set `fail_under = 80` in `[tool.coverage.report]`.

Coverage.declare: Declare pytest-cov (or coverage) as a dev dependency and configure it in `pyproject.toml` so local runs match CI.
Coverage.ci: Run tests with coverage in CI and enforce the threshold, e.g. `pytest --cov --cov-fail-under=80`.

setup.title: Add pip-audit for dependency audit
bullets: Add pip-audit as a dev dependency.

Dependency audit.declare: Declare pip-audit as a dev dependency so local runs match CI.

unittest.title: Run tests with pytest instead of unittest
bullets: pytest executes existing unittest tests unchanged and aligns with pytest-cov.

coverage_threshold.title: Set a coverage threshold of at least 80
bullets: Set `fail_under = 80` in `[tool.coverage.report]` (or `--cov-fail-under=80`) so CI fails when coverage drops.

coverage_threshold_low.title: Raise the coverage threshold to at least 80
bullets: Current threshold is {value}%; the recommended minimum is 80%.

external.title: Verify external workflows
bullets: Check manually that the external reusable workflow(s) run the gates marked EXTERNAL: {workflows}.
